_about: LOCITIZE ships NO model list (owner decision 2026-08-29). Which model a
person runs is their choice: first-run setup scans the machine for GGUFs
they already have and imports them, and the Models page's Get models
section searches huggingface.co in the user's own words, with every
download checksum-verified. This file remains as the (empty) catalog the
hub merges over search results, so a fork that WANTS to curate a list for
its own audience can fill it back in - the loading rules from M14.14.1
still apply: no location keys, no stored hashes, sizes are hints only.
